column3: “The covenant loyalty of God” is rendered “the kindness of God,” and “stricken of feet” as “crippled.”
“Saul your father” is rendered “your grandfather Saul,” and “continually” as “regularly.”
“The son of your master” is rendered “your master’s grandson.”
NASB supplies “the produce” and “nevertheless,” and renders “son of your master” as “grandson.”
The Hebrew reads “at my table”; NASB has “at David’s table.”
